title: Secret Lair Drop Series: Marvel's Deadpool: I Fixed It (You're Welcome)

paragraphs.text: Marvel's Deadpool: I Fixed It (You're Welcome) is a drop of cards in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the alternate art Secret Lair Drop Series . Similar to the 2025 Deadpool drop , it became available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com on April 1st, 2026 (dubbed "April 'Pools Day").

This drop is a continuation of the collaboration between Hasbro ( Wizards of the Coast ) and Marvel Entertainment . It features five altered cards , each of which has been styled as an "upgrade" by Marvel character Deadpool . The treatment is in the same style as the Blacker Lotus bonus card that appeared with Secret Lair Drop Series: Marvel's Deadpool . The cards are available in both traditional foil and a new Dazzle foil (labelled "Pool Party foil"), which appears similar to confetti foils but with a higher density of refraction points. The dazzle foil cards are slightly different from the other two treatments, generally featuring more "Deadpool" additions across the card face than their traditional- and non-foil counterparts.
A copy of all three versions of the drop (non-foil, traditional foil, and dazzle foil) is available for purchase through the "FINAL_final_REALLYfinal_v7_USETHISONE(2)_Everything Bundle" for $124.99.

As an extra, the drop comes with one of two surprise bonus cards. The dazzle-foil versions of the cards have separate collector numbers from the non-foil cards along with additional illustration flourishes to represent the "pool party".
